chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Abu Tharr is a friend (or truthful one) of this nation.

key_terms.أَبُو ذَرٍّ: Abu Tharr, a prominent companion of the Prophet known for his asceticism and honesty.
key_terms.الْأُمَّةِ: The nation or community, referring to the Muslim community.
key_terms.صِدِّيقُ: A friend, confidant, or one who is consistently truthful; here indicating a close, trusted status.

ai.seo_question: What title did the Prophet give to Abu Tharr regarding his status in the community?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) designates Abu Tharr al-Ghifari as the 'Siddiq' (truthful one) of the Ummah, a title that underscores his unparalleled sincerity and adherence to truth. This designation is particularly significant in Shia scholarship as it highlights Abu Tharr’s role as a model of asceticism and independent thought, often cited to illustrate the virtue of *Tawhid* in action and his close alignment with the Ahl al-Bayt's spiritual ethos.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-284 According to the same documentation on the authority of Ali (a.s.), the Prophet (S) said, “
Abu Tharr is a friend of this nation.”
